# Staff Site Reliability Engineer

## Summary
Site reliability and platform engineer with 10 years of experience running production infrastructure for enterprise SaaS products. Works in Python and Go.

## Experience
**Staff Site Reliability Engineer -- Larkwater Cloud (synthetic, enterprise SaaS)** (2019-present)
- Runs the production platform on AWS (EKS, EC2, RDS, S3) for an enterprise SaaS product: 300 services on Kubernetes, packaged as Docker images.
- Manages all infrastructure as code with Terraform; built the CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) every team deploys through.
- Built monitoring and alerting with Prometheus and Grafana; leads on-call and incident response, and writes the postmortems.
- Did capacity planning and performance tuning for the PostgreSQL fleet (RDS) and the Linux hosts under it; debugged kernel and network (TCP, DNS) problems in production.
- Mentored four engineers and set the technical direction for the platform team's three-year roadmap.

**Site Reliability Engineer -- Pinebrook Systems (synthetic)** (2015-2019)
- Wrote deployment and automation tooling in Python and Go for Linux fleets on AWS.
- Moved the build and release system to containers (Docker) and wrote the service runbooks.

## Skills
Python, Go, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Prometheus, Grafana, PostgreSQL, Linux, CI/CD, incident response
